title: Defense Feedback and Global-Game Selection
abstract: arXiv:2610.00323v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Global games select a unique cutoff when a player's incentive moves monotonically with private information. We show that this logic can fail when a privately informed participant can take a costly, simultaneous, and unobserved action that defends the status quo. In a currency-attack model, the defender acts only at intermediate signals. Along the traders' cutoff equation, this interval response creates an endogenous defense-loss term that vanishes at the endpoints of an activation component but can dominate the decreasing benchmark payoff margin in between. We establish a primitive region in which defense is inactive and uniqueness survives, and a finite-CDF overshoot condition under which two active-defense cutoff roots coexist with the inactive benchmark root. translated_title: 防御反馈与全局博弈选择
translated_abstract: 全局博弈在参与者激励随私人信息单调变化时，能够选出唯一的临界值。我们证明，当拥有私人信息的参与者可以采取一种代价高昂、同时进行且不被观察到的行动来捍卫现状时，这一逻辑可能会失效。在一个货币攻击模型中，防御者只会在中等信号区间采取行动。沿着交易者的临界值方程，这种区间性反应会产生一个内生的防御损失项，该项在激活区间的端点处消失，但在区间内部可能超过递减的基准收益差额。我们刻画了一个防御不活跃、唯一性得以保留的基础参数区域，并给出一个有限CDF超越条件，在该条件下两个防御活跃的临界值根会与不活跃的基准根共存。由于边际无差异并不必然意味着全局激励，我们还给出了真实单调临界值最优反应的充分条件。最后，向外圆化的区间……
tldr: 本文在货币攻击模型中证明，当拥有私人信息的参与者能够采取代价高昂且不被观察到的防御性行动捍卫现状时，全局博弈的唯一临界值选择结论可能失效，并刻画了唯一性得以保留的基础参数区域以及多个临界值根共存的有限CDF超越条件。
en_tdlr: Using a currency-attack model, this paper shows that global-game cutoff uniqueness can fail when a privately informed participant takes a costly, unobserved action defending the status quo, establishing a primitive region where uniqueness survives and a finite-CDF overshoot condition under which two active-defense cutoff roots coexist with the inactive benchmark root.
